name: Substitution Crossing Width
definition: For a proper nonempty test $T\subsetneq\{0,1\}^Y$ on $n=|Y|$ coordinates, define $g(T)=n-\min\{t_{\min}(T),t_{\min}(T^{\mathrm c})\}$.
parameters: A proper nonempty Boolean test and its displayed ambient cube.
normalization: The value is not assigned to an empty or full test; those substitution cases reduce to a section times a cube.
comments: Equivalently, this is the largest isolating-face dimension or largest inclusion-minimal disagreement crossing between the test and its complement.
